data.body: Fifth plan-review remediation for blocking finding f81034227578a46fd: added `config` to the exact `_NESTED_INTERCEPTS` set; documented that `config validate` is a handler-dispatched pseudo-subcommand with no populated argparse `_SubParsersAction` and therefore cannot be discovered by parser introspection; and added an explicit `rebar config validate --help` plan and acceptance check proving control reaches `build_validate` and returns validate child help instead of top-level config help. The 35-path material scope remains unchanged, as do the explicit rejection of mechanical writing enforcement and the Markdown-only reduced test policy.
